claims.claim: Century completed the Mt. Holly restart that expands U.S. primary aluminum output and is a 40% partner in a planned 750,000-tonne Oklahoma smelter expected to more than double current U.S. primary-aluminum production.

risks.risk: New-smelter economics are highly sensitive to power, alumina, aluminum prices, construction cost and project execution.

unknowns.unknown: Final capital structure, schedule and Century funding burden for the Oklahoma project remain key underwriting items.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 net sales rose sequentially to $752.1M, shipments increased to 130,632 tonnes, adjusted EBITDA rose to $326.9M, liquidity reached $784.9M, and Q3 adjusted EBITDA guidance was $325M-$345M.

risks.risk: Results remain materially commodity- and power-price-sensitive; Q2 included exceptional items tied to Iceland equipment failures.

unknowns.unknown: How much current profitability persists under normalized aluminum premiums and power costs is unresolved.
